name: Firecrawl
tagline: Web scraping and data extraction API for crawling and extracting structured data from websites.
description: Firecrawl is a web scraping and data extraction platform that converts websites into clean, structured data. Crawl entire websites, extract specific data with LLM-powered parsing, handle JavaScript-rendered content, and get structured JSON output. Perfect for data collection, research, and content extraction at scale.
author: firecrawl
